title: Host does not consume Engram's control_store_busy refusal explicitly; a busy refusal is treated as a generic unknown remote error
outcome: Consume Engram's exact control_store_busy contract as a typed retryable current-invocation no-commit refusal, preserving exact retained requests, binding/grant/report, prior uncertainty and existing ownership/durability/budget fences; do not extend that certainty to generic storage failures or add a fresh-key/rebind/busy-loop escape.
acceptance: Only a valid host-private Remote error with exact code control_store_busy for session_bind, turn_evaluate, turn_begin or turn_checkpoint is classified as a typed transient refusal certifying no new commit by that invocation. The code, safe operation/attempt attribution and current-attempt guarantee are retained; process_never_started is not asserted.

A busy refusal retains the exact original request, payload, idempotency key, control connection and still-valid binding. Bind keeps its unbound/bound intent; Evaluate keeps its intent; Begin keeps its prepared grant and delivery tokens; checkpoint keeps its complete cached report and key. Busy alone never arms a rebind, rotates authority, drops or substitutes the report, or permits provider handoff.

A fresh Begin refused busy does not acquire new possibly-begun uncertainty merely from that response. Busy on an exact replay does not clear any pre-existing possibly-applied/begun or delivery uncertainty. Generic storage_error, commit/rollback failures, unknown codes, invalid envelopes, transport loss and deadlines retain their existing conservative certainty and operation-specific reconciliation behavior.

Busy retries use the existing owned, durably acknowledged retained-operation and bounded admission/operation-budget mechanisms, with the same prompt, generation, grant and authority fences. Repeated busy cannot create an unbounded immediate resend loop, a fresh key or budget, or bypass Stop, Cancel, operator pause, expiry, reset, replacement, revocation or a superseded owner; exhausted or invalid authority stays visibly held.

Permanent regression tests cover real error-envelope decoding, busy-then-exact-success for bind/Evaluate/Begin/checkpoint, earlier-applied replay followed by busy, nonempty checkpoint-report retention, generic-error negatives and owner/budget controls. Documentation cites the pinned producer guarantee and limitations. The exact final input passes the maintained full five-stage gate compiled in this item's named root and the required independent review pair with no outstanding in-scope Medium or higher; failures and unavailable live-store proof remain explicit.
